args.text: Draft the Hartford incident summary for Mateo's procurement team here: first report time, when kiosk 1 came back, and when both lanes were confirmed working.

@gideon.sato here is the draft for Mateo's procurement team, built from #inc-vtg-hartford (Aug 3, 2026 times as logged there):

DRAFT: Vantorre Hartford gate kiosk incident, Aug 3, 2026
- First report: 10:42 AM. Gate kiosks offline after badge scan; both inbound lanes showing a white screen. Gate check-in affected, scheduling from the dispatch office unaffected.
- Kiosk 1 restored: 11:03 AM. Trailer 8836 checked in and visible to dispatch.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM (per Gideon Sato's update at 11:08 AM). Incident left open for another arrival cycle.
- Open item: status-page access for the procurement login is still being worked on under INC-4821. Reconnect logs were sent to Odile Brandt.

Note: the incident times are from the Aug 3 log, not today's date (Oct 14). Gideon, please confirm before this goes to Mateo.

FINAL: Vantorre Hartford gate kiosk incident, Aug 3, 2026 (for Mateo's procurement team)
